listing.name: Triad Shields 1.2.3
listing.summary: Adds Triad Shields, an unused system supposadly made for omega. Currently, the Tesseract and Facet have it, but you can get it as a hullmod if you beat a hypershunt.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Triad Shields system, a cell-based skinshield available on specific ships or as a hullmod reward.

description: Adds the Triad Shields system, originally an unused mechanic for the Omega. It functions as a cell-based skinshield that can be obtained via hypershunt rewards.

changelog.1.2.2:
Triad shields OP increased
Triad shields are now suppressed by incoming fire if they are down
changelog.1.2.1:
Fixes large ships not having total shield coverage
Fixes AI ships holding fire with triad shields
changelog.1.2.0:
EMP Arcs are now blocked
Movingrays now have correct collision for real
Phase now pauses regen

Added limited punchthrough
 If an attack breakas a shield node, the remainder of its damage is spread across adjacent cells

Massively reduced raycast overhead
Reduced collision overhead

Refactored triad shields a bit
Shields now prevent triad shield collision
